name: Antae
description: Antae: the thickened ends of a wall, treated as if they were columns.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8%; width: 22%; height: 84%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-shadow: calc(52px * 6 / @size-col) 0 0 @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8%; width: 100%; height: 14%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
